note: Cancer cachexia in adult patients, ESMO Clinical Practice Guidelines 2021. Cachexia assessment and multimodal treatment in advanced disease -- the axis the corpus was blind to.

default.note: Cachexia is defined by the patient's metabolic state rather than by the tumour's stage. A patient with metastatic bladder cancer and one with locally advanced prostate cancer are the same question here. Serves supportive_care throughout: Recognising and managing cachexia.

rules.note: Leaf-matched and every occurrence: the conversion files the reference list under whichever chapter happens to be last, so its path is not predictable but its own heading is.
